test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

Q W _ R T Q _ F R _ Q W _ _ T _ _ H R T

options.text: F W T G R Q X
E X T G R Q X
E W T G R Q W
E W T H S Q W

solution:
Given: Q W _ R T Q _ F R _ Q W _ _ T _ _ H R T

Explantion:

Let's check each option:

1) F W T G R Q X → Q W **F **R T - Q **W** F R **T** - Q W **G R** T - **Q X** H R T 

2) E X T G R Q X → Q W **E** R T - Q **X** F R **T** - Q W **G R** T - **Q X** H R T

**3) E W T G R Q W **→ Q W __**E** __R T - Q __**W **__F R **__T__ - **Q W __**G**__ __**R**__ T - __**Q W**__ H R T

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a91828921e00b60d10f909a2cf523f524d0d227180413ff19afceeb77d9f974b.png] 

4) E W T H S Q W → Q W **E** R T - Q **W **F R **T** - Q W **H S** T - **Q W** H R T

So, In option 3 "QWERT" is repeating itself. E is rotating by its next letter.

Hence, ‘E W T G R Q W " is the correct answer.
